visualCharacteristics.purpose: Editorial index: stacked rows of a large accent number beside a heading and paragraph, separated by rules
visualCharacteristics.layout: Vertical list in a narrow column; each row is number | text side by side, stacked on small screens
visualCharacteristics.description: Warm beige section band, narrow column. Three numbered items separated by orange rules: large orange number (01/02/03) left, h3 + grey paragraph right.

contentPattern.structure: one row per item, two cells: [number, e.g. 01] [H3, paragraph]
contentPattern.notes: The number is decorative (aria-hidden) and is not part of the heading. If an author omits the number cell, the row position is used (01, 02, ...). Rendered as an ordered list.

usage: How We Work section on the WKND Adventures homepage.
reuseGuidance: Use for numbered principles, steps or process lists where each item has a short heading and body copy.
